directory.title: Host schools worldwide
directory.introBody: schools have passed GSA's gold-standard verification and are actively promoted. Verified hosts are checked members of the network.
directory.emptyBody: The network is growing every week. Try widening your filters, or check back soon.

profile.listedHost: Listed host · not yet GSA Verified
profile.verificationBody: Download the GSA verification statement — what we checked and when, ready to hand to your head, governors, or EVC.
profile.planBody: Build the trip around a school immersion here — choose dates, add flights, attractions and accommodation, reserve places with a refundable £1,000 deposit, and manage payments in one place.
profile.enquireBody: Enquiries go to the GSA team, who facilitate every visit and will come back to you within a few days.
profile.sentTitle: Enquiry sent — here's what happens next:
profile.sentStep1: You'll get a confirmation email with a copy of your enquiry.
profile.sentStep2: A member of the GSA team reviews it and contacts you within 2–3 working days.
profile.sentStep3: GSA introduces you to the school and supports planning from there — you're never left to arrange things alone.
profile.message: What are you hoping to do?
profile.messageHint: Tell us about your group, what kind of visit you have in mind, and anything else useful.
profile.send: Send enquiry to the GSA team
profile.noCommitment: No commitment — this starts a conversation, not a booking.

pay.paidBody: Received {date}. This page is your receipt; you'll also get the pre-departure pack via the school.
pay.processingBody: Thanks — your card payment is being confirmed. This page will show as paid once it clears.
pay.transferNote: Pay by bank transfer using the details on your school's trip letter — the GSA team will confirm your payment here within a working day.
pay.testMode: Test mode — no real money moves through this page.
